blurb: BridgeMill Athletic Club provides a variety of sports and fitness activities including tennis, pickleball, swimming, and youth fitness classes. The club features a 2-acre aquatic center, fitness center with modern equipment, and multiple courts for tennis and pickleball. Programs cater to all ages and skill levels, with private lessons, group classes, and leagues.
extraNote: Court reservations for pickleball: 3 days in advance for members, 1 day for athletic members · Members may bring up to 2 accompanied guests to fitness center or pickleball courts · Guest fee $10 per visit · Pool members must have photo in database for entry
